meta.name: learning-vault
meta.description: Generate a dedicated Obsidian learning vault for any certification, course, or study goal. Creates structured notes with domains, concepts, lessons, scenarios, MoCs, dataview queries, action items, and multiple navigation paths. Inspired by the genome vault pattern. Use when the user wants to create a study vault, learning vault, certification prep vault, or structured knowledge base for a learning goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成结构化学习笔记，系统掌握知识体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在备考或学习新课程，需要高效整理知识
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured learning notes to master any subject
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize knowledge for exams or courses

howto.what: 当你告诉它学习目标后，它会自动生成一个完整的 Obsidian 学习仓库，包含按领域、概念、课程、练习等分类的笔记，以及进度追踪、复习任务和导航页面。
howto.when: 当你说“为XXX创建学习仓库”、“建立学习笔记仓库”或“准备XX认证仓库”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 为 AWS 解决方案架构师认证创建一个学习仓库。
say.note: 生成一个包含5个领域、多个概念和练习的仓库。

say.text: 为 Rust 编程语言创建一个学习笔记仓库。
say.note: 生成一个包含课程、概念和复习任务的仓库。

say.text: 为机器学习课程创建一个备考仓库。
say.note: 生成一个按课程和自评优先级排序的学习仓库。

howto.what_en: When you specify a learning goal (certification, course, skill), it generates a full Obsidian vault with structured notes: domains, concepts, lessons, scenarios, MoCs, dataview queries, action items, and navigation paths. It also asks setup questions and creates a study plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'create a learning vault for X', 'build a study vault', or 'set up a certification vault'. Also works with '/learning-vault'.

say_en.text: Create a learning vault for the AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam.
say_en.note: Generates a vault with domains like Compute, Storage, etc., and a study plan.

say_en.text: Build a study vault for Rust programming.
say_en.note: Creates a vault with concepts, courses, and review tasks.

say_en.text: Set up a certification vault for Machine Learning.
